offer.label: Coaching pilot

pilot.note: Intended capacity of the pilot cohort. Availability is limited and is never quantified on the site: no remaining places, days, hours, or start dates are published.

single.name: Single session
single.summary: One 60-minute session. Enough to look at a single situation properly, or to find out what this coaching actually feels like before committing to more.
single.suits: You want to explore coaching without a larger commitment, or you have one thing you would like to think through with someone.

package.name: Six-session package
package.summary: Six 60-minute sessions at $35 each. Enough room to notice a pattern, test something, and revise it.
package.suits: You want continuity: applying the approach in ordinary life between sessions, and reflecting on what actually happens.

offer.paymentNote: Nothing is charged on this site. Scheduling and payment are arranged directly with me once we have spoken and agreed that the work is a fit, and you will have the terms in writing before you pay anything.

refund.note: The refund example on the policy page is computed from the prices above; the build fails if the stated figure stops agreeing with the arithmetic.

cancellation.label: Cancellation and rescheduling
cancellation.summary: You can cancel or reschedule with at least 24 hours’ notice without losing the session.

lateCancellation.label: Late cancellations
lateCancellation.summary: Each client gets one courtesy exception for a late cancellation. After that, a cancellation with less than 24 hours’ notice may count as a completed session.

refunds.label: Refunds and unused sessions
refunds.summary: A single session is refundable if it has not taken place and the cancellation policy has been met. Unused sessions in the six-session package can be refunded on request, with completed sessions recalculated at the single-session rate of $50. The refund is the greater of zero and the amount paid minus $50 for each completed session — so after two completed sessions, a $210 package would be refunded $110. The recalculation never results in an additional charge.

expiry.label: Using the package
expiry.summary: The six-session package is intended to be used within six months of the first session. If illness or another exceptional circumstance gets in the way, ask me about an extension — unused sessions are not forfeited as a matter of course.

introCall.label: Before we begin
introCall.summary: Getting in touch costs nothing, and there is no standard complimentary introductory call. An enquiry may lead to an email exchange, a paid coaching session, or a referral elsewhere, depending on what you bring and what I can offer at the time.

availability.label: Availability
availability.note: The pilot's intended capacity is five clients (offer.pilot.capacity). Still to decide: days, times, time zone, and whether places are open. Nothing about scheduling is published beyond 'limited'; the site never claims places remain or that a start date is available.

payment.label: Payment handling
payment.note: Not finalised, and deliberately not published. Decide how payment is collected (e-transfer, invoice, or a processor) and at what point in the process before quoting it on the site.

taxes.label: Taxes
taxes.note: Not finalised, and deliberately not published. Decide whether prices are tax-inclusive, and whether GST/HST registration applies to coaching in Ontario. Do not state a rate or imply registration status until that is settled.

legalReview.label: Consumer-protection review
legalReview.note: The cancellation, refund, and expiry terms above are business intentions, not a completed legal review. Before they are published as binding terms, have an Ontario consumer-protection or contract question checked: prepaid services, notice periods, and refund entitlements for unused sessions. Do not treat the current wording as legal advice.
